guard: status skills rows recommend setup --skills, and setup --skills is the only write that path performs
why: A status surface that names unscoped cotal setup as the skills remedy routes a read-path user into persona, plugin, and onboard writes.
Each mutation is compile-clean and unique in the named file. Restoring the unscoped remedy, skipping the skills-only dispatch, or combining --skills with --full must redden the named cell.

mutations.name: S1 restore unscoped Claude skills remedy
mutations.note: Restores the issue's Claude skills row. Typecheck stays green. The status subprocess still prints the header.

mutations.name: S2 restore unscoped .agents skills remedy
mutations.note: Restores the issue's Skills (.agents) row while leaving the Claude row scoped.

mutations.name: S3 drop the skills-only dispatch
mutations.expectRed: setup --skills does not seed a default persona
mutations.cell: setup --skills does not seed a default persona
mutations.note: Keeps the flag but falls through to the onboarded ensure path, which seeds default.md.

mutations.name: S4 allow --skills with --full
mutations.find: if (values.full || values.demo) throw new Error("--skills cannot be combined with --full or --demo");
mutations.replace: if (false && (values.full || values.demo)) throw new Error("--skills cannot be combined with --full or --demo");
mutations.note: Compile-clean no-op of the combination fence. First-run --full then writes personas.
